item.title: 'I've become very aware of the volunteerism and how hard it is'
item.description: Former Dublin captain Denise Masterson is excited to have been afforded the opportunity to be in Croke Park this Saturday as the inaugural Club Summit gets up and running at the Jones' Road venue.

item.title: Cats looking foward to "huge test" against Limerick - Lyng
item.description: Kilkenny manager Derek Lyng says his side are looking forward to "a huge test" against Limerick this weekend in the third round of the Allianz Hurling League.

item.title: "I was always chasing perfection, and never, ever was going to get it"
item.description: Laura Treacy stands in the middle of Croke Park with a beaming smile.

item.title: Early Murphy goal helps UCC into Sigerson Cup final
item.description: UCC moved into the Sigerson Cup final thanks to a hard-fought 1-11 to 1-8 win against University of Galway at the Mardyke last night.

item.title: Double blow for Antrim as key pair depart squad
item.description: Antrim's senior footballers are set to be without Paddy McBride and Conor Small for the remainder of their season with the news that both players have stepped away from the panel.

item.title: Venue details confirmed for 2026 Munster SHC final
item.description: Munster GAA have confirmed the date and venue permutations for this summer's Munster senior hurling championship final.

item.title: "I don't think there'll be any shadow-boxing, these two will go at it"
item.description: Clare legend Anthony Daly says he doesn't expect any "shadow-boxing" when Cork and Tipperary collide tomorrow evening at Pairc Ui Chaoimh (7.30pm)

item.title: Morris and O'Donoghue return for Tipp
item.description: Tipperary manager Liam Cahill has made five changes to his side for tomorrow evening's crunch Allianz Hurling League clash against Cork at Pairc Ui Chaoimh.

item.title: GAA on TV: Six games to watch live this weekend as Allianz Hurling League takes centre stage
item.description: This weekend sees some mouthwatering clashes ahead with third round fixtures in the Allianz Hurling League down decision.

item.title: "I've a whole new sort of hunger for it after the few months away last year"
item.description: After missing out on the majority of last year's inter-county season, Fermanagh's Brenda Bannon has come into 2026 with a renewed appetite and an added layer of responsibility.
